info.title: Pizza 4P's POS Till API
info.description: The `/api` surface the till, the kitchen display and POS Station call on a store's edge, generated from the handlers (ADR-0177). A device presents its pairing token as a bearer token, and most routes also need a person signed in on it. A refusal is plain text, with its AIP-193 reason in the `pos-error-reason` header where the edge names one.

get.summary:
`GET /api/floor` — the store's published floor plan and kitchen stations, read from the live
session (ADR-0072).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the copy the till holds

200.description: `floor`, the published areas and tables; `stations`, the kitchen stations and routing, each station with the threshold its board marks a ticket late after; and each table's live state. Empty until a floor is published. The ETag tags this body

304.description: If-None-Match names the current ETag: nothing changed, and no body is sent

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

get.summary: `GET /api/integrations` — the connections that serve this store, most specific first.

200.description: The vendor connections that serve this store, most specific first: each one's family, provider and name. No setting is returned

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the copy the till holds

200.description: How the till groups and orders its buttons: the display categories, their sub-categories, and each item's caption and grid slot. No prices. An empty plan means the till draws the flat price book. The ETag tags this body

304.description: If-None-Match names the current ETag: nothing changed, and no body is sent

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the copy the till holds

200.description: The money facts the pay screen needs: the currency, the notes a guest can hand over, and what a total rounds to in cash. Empty until a `locale` node is published. The ETag tags this body

304.description: If-None-Match names the current ETag: nothing changed, and no body is sent

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

get.summary: `GET /api/menu` — the store's published price book, read from the live session.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the copy the till holds

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: A sales channel's wire token. Absent means the store's own channel

200.description: The published price book for the channel: its currency, and each item with its price, tax and whether it is sold out. The ETag tags this body

304.description: If-None-Match names the current ETag: nothing changed, and no body is sent

400.description: channel is not a sales channel this edge knows, or the query is not one this route reads

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

requestBody.description: `code`, the six-digit pairing code a manager minted

200.description: Paired: the body carries `device_token`, the bearer token the device presents from now on

400.description: The code is not six digits

403.description: The code is unknown or has expired

429.description: Too many attempts: wait and try again

503.description: The pairing could not be recorded

get.summary:
`GET /api/pair/devices` — which devices are paired, when each paired, and whether that survives a
restart.
get.description:
The list used to be a bare count, which left an operator with a lost tablet nothing to act on:
`POST /api/pair/revoke` takes a device id, and no surface anywhere handed one out
(production-readiness **O1**). The pairing instant is the only handle the edge has on *which*
tablet a row is — the device's name lives in the cloud's approved-device registry, and a store
that has never synced has none — so the console shows when each paired and marks the caller's own
row, which together are enough to recognise the odd one out.

The token digest is never returned: it correlates a device across restarts and buys the console
nothing the id does not.

200.description: How many devices are paired, whether pairings survive a restart, and each device's id, when it paired and whether it is the caller. No token digest

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

get.summary:
`GET /api/pair/this_device` — whether the calling token is still accepted, and which device it
belongs to.
get.description:
POS Station's token probe
([ADR-0158](../../../../docs/adr/0158-the-till-enforces-each-persons-own-permissions.md)
decision 8, step 1). It answers for the calling token **alone**: its device id and when it
paired, and nothing about any other device. [`paired_devices`] answered the same question by
handing every paired device the id of every other, which a probe has no use for and which
decision 8 stops once no Station that reads the list is left.

Behind the paired-device gate alone, for the reason the list is: Station asks with nobody signed
in. The route never reaches the signed-in gate, which is the only code that reads or touches a
session, so asking it signs nobody in and resets nobody's idle window.

An unknown or retired token is refused `401` by the gate, before this runs. A token retired in
the moment between the gate and the lookup below is refused the same way, because by the time the
answer is written it is no longer accepted. The device comes from the gate and never from the
request, so a router that lost the gate fails the request `500` rather than answer for nobody.

200.description: The calling token is accepted: `accepted`, its `device_id` and `pair_time`

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

get.summary: `GET /api/printers` — the printers this store published, in publication order.

200.description: The printers this store published, in publication order

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

get.summary:
`GET /api/reason-codes` — the active entries of the store's managed list, read from the live
session.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the copy the till holds

200.description: The active entries of the store's managed reason list, each with its id, code, name in the store's display language and the actions it covers. The framework's list until one is published. The ETag tags this body

304.description: If-None-Match names the current ETag: nothing changed, and no body is sent

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

get.summary: `GET /api/reports/takings` — what the store has taken in the current business day.
get.description:
`403` with `PERMISSION_DENIED` for a person whose own role does not grant
`reports.takings.view`: the device is paired and somebody is signed in, so the answer is about
standing, not about signing in again.

200.description: The current business day, what its settled bills came to, and how many there were. The store's figure only: no person, till or shift

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in, or the person's own role lacks reports.takings.view (`pos-error-reason: PERMISSION_DENIED`)

get.summary:
`GET /api/session` — who is signed in on this (paired) device, so the UI resumes on the right screen
after a reload without re-typing a PIN.

200.description: Whether anyone is signed in on this device and who; the box's lease standing; whether anyone can sign in; the person's permissions, held directly and with approval; the till's idle lock; and the opening float

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

post.summary:
`POST /api/session/sign-in` — verify a badge code + PIN against the synced roster and, on success,
bind the signed-in employee to this device (S0b/ADR-0084).

requestBody.description: `code`, the badge code a person types, and `pin`. Both are secrets and are never logged

200.description: Signed in: the body carries the `employee_id` the device now acts as

401.description: Refused: `outcome` is `wrong` or `locked_out`, with `remaining` attempts or `locked_until_ms`. A wrong code and a wrong PIN answer the same; an unpaired device also gets 401

503.description: The sign-in could not be recorded

post.summary:
`POST /api/session/sign-out` — clear the sign-in on this device (end of shift, or handing the tablet
on). Idempotent: signing out a device nobody is signed in on still returns `204`.

204.description: Signed out, or nobody was signed in

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

get.summary: `GET /api/sync` — the outbox depth, its level, the cloud link, and the box's clock.

200.description: The outbox depth and its level against the planned depth, the cloud link, when the outbox last reached the cloud, and the box's measured clock offset. The store sells at any depth

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: Nobody is signed in on this device, or the sign-in lapsed

200.description: `status` `ok`, the binary's name and version, the protocol version it speaks, and the store it serves. No credential is needed

get.summary: Upgrades `GET /ws` to a WebSocket and pumps the fan-out into it.
get.description:
Reached only through the paired-device gate: an unpaired host on the store LAN is refused `401`
before this runs. Until S0c that gate was absent and this endpoint served the whole
committed-event stream — orders, bills, settlements — to anyone who could route to the box.

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.description: The stream the device's last applied frame is on, to resume after it

parameters.name: after_sequence
parameters.description: The sequence of that frame. Sent with stream_id or not at all

parameters.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
parameters.description: `pos-edge.v1` and, from a browser, the device token, which cannot travel in Authorization on an upgrade

101.description: Upgraded: the device receives the store's live frames, resumed after the named position where the fan-out can

401.description: This device is not paired: no token, or one the edge does not accept

403.description: The request comes from an origin the edge does not permit

tags.name: session

tags.name: published configuration
tags.description: What the cloud published to this store, read from the live session. A configuration read answers 304 to an If-None-Match that names its ETag (ADR-0173).

tags.name: status
tags.description: The box's own state: liveness, the outbox and the cloud link, today's takings, and the live fan-out.
